notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
We've updated Dudelings with a series of features and fixes that should improve the gameplay experience! We're super stoked for this new client release as it's addressed a few long-standing issues and we're excited for your feedback.

You'll find our changelog below. If you encounter an issue, sound off in the comments or [url=https://rvlt.gg/Fd6HtSRj]join our Revolt server[/url].

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Reorganized game assets to simplify the process of exporting them into the FOSS build of the game[/*]
    [*]Made some upgrades to the game’s assets to reduce overall download/disk usage size[/*]
    [*]Backported some features/assets of the Android build to the main branch
        [list]
            [*]This included re-encoding the video files in the how to play and launch movie to lower bitrates[/*]
            [*]Removing the video file that played in the background of the Main Menu and replacing it with static images that were animated in Godot[/*]
            [*]Backported the custom virtual gamepad in the Android port to the main branch[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]Added a link to our new Revolt server on the Main Menu[/*]
    [*]Changed all links & references to our new canonical domain name: heavyelement.com[/*]
    [*]Made some changes to the underlying code to unify the demo and retail codebase as much as possible
        [list]
            [*]The demo features one map, one game mode, and some customization features disabled. It should be on Steam soon![/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Fixed instances where game would randomly fail to launch on Intel graphics under Linux operating systems[/*]
    [*]Fixed a glitch where the ball could get stuck between the left- or right-most Dudeling and get placed out of bounds[/*]
    [*]Fixed an issue with unlocking “Destination” map where criteria was met, but the map didn’t unlock until the game was restarted[/*]
    [*]Fixed a visual glitch where labels for CheckButtons would disappear when in a hover state (thanks moocow1452)[/*]
    [*]Fixed an issue where requests to the news endpoint failed silently[/*]
    [*]Improved error handling for new news items on the Main Menu and in the What’s New submenu[/*]
[/list]

Also, if you're a coder, we've got good news! We've launched the [url=https://github.com/heavyelementinc/dudelings-foss]official Dudelings FOSS project on GitHub[/url]. This build was actually produced using the first release of our free and open source codebase. If you're interested in helping out, let us know!

[h2]Dudelings Demo[/h2]
Finally, we've got excellent news! We've produced a demo version of Dudelings! Our goal is to get the game in front of folks, allow them to give it a try, and make an informed decision on if this game is worth $5. (We think it is).

The demo is available for Linux and Windows, so give that a shot.

The other thing about the demo is that it gives a free entrypoint into the open source version of the game. The assets are not licensed under the GPL, so if you want to get into development and you don't own a copy, you can download and extract the demo's assets for use with Dudelings FOSS!

notes.title: Dudelings: 2nd Base is now live!
notes.content:
Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball just received its first major update, codenamed "2nd Base," featuring a massive collection of features, fixes, and improvements to help you get your sport on!
So what's new?

[i]Where do we even start?[/i]
[h2]Presentation[/h2]
The first thing you might've noticed is the brand new CRT filter! When designing the art for the game, we had always imagined it as a Super Nintendo title. This filter lends a bit more authenticity to the design (in that kind of [i]simulacra[/i] way). But if a CRT Filter isn't your style, you can turn it off in Settings → CRT Filter.

Then, we've added a whole bunch of new jerseys designs to the game. Jerseys have always been purely cosmetic (meaning they have no impact on the gameplay), so we decided to move them to the Settings menu. Your jersey selection will persist across game sessions and you can even change them mid-match!

[h2]Announcers[/h2]
[i]2nd Base[/i] features the voice talent of some familiar [i]voices[/i]. YouTube sensations "[url=https://www.youtube.com/@FanTheDeck]FanTheDeck[/url]" and "[url=https://www.youtube.com/@NerdNest]NerdNest[/url]" have stepped up to fill the Announcer role! Select either announcer pack in Settings → Announcer Voice and enjoy the dulcet narration of some of your favorite YouTubers.

Thanks again to FanTheDeck and NerdNest for joining the Dudelings cast!

[h2]New Game Mode[/h2]
[i]2nd Base[/i] introduces a new (and exceptionally fun) game mode that we're calling "Pins." The play field is littered with a symmetrical series of pins: six for each team. Hit the ball into your opponent's pins to knock 'em down. Once all six of their pins are down, you earn a point and their pins are reset. But watch out, because yours won't reset until they score a point on you!

[h2]New Rules[/h2]
Dudelings has always had the option to customize your match rules. But [i]2nd Base[/i] introduces a brand new and exciting victory condition: Timed Matches. Don't worry, the traditional way to play Dudelings—with a fixed Match Point—is still available. However, Timed Matches bring a whole new frenzy to the game.

And if there's a tie when the time's up, the game will head into Overtime where the rules change to SUDDEN DEATH! The next player to score wins!

Now, Match Points haven't gone anywhere. In fact, they're still the default rule for most game types. However, an interesting change we've made is to how rules are applied.

With this update, each Game Mode ([i]Classic[/i], [i]Hoop[/i], etc.) has its own default ruleset! For example, [i]Pin[/i] games default to 5 match points, rather than the default 10. [i]Volley[/i] now defaults to a 3 minute Timed Match. And [i]Hoop[/i] now uses the Bowling Ball by default!

Of course, you can change any of these yourself. Meaning [i]Volley[/i] can be a Match Point game, [i]Classic[/i] can be a Timed Match, etc. And you can tweak the other rules (like which pickups are allowed to spawn) just as before.

Speaking of which...

[h2]New Pickups[/h2]
There are two new Pickups that come with [i]2nd Base[/i]. The first is [b]Switchup[/b]. When your ball touches a [b]Switchup[/b] coin, it will flip to the other team's possession!

Then, there's the [b]Black Hole[/b] which works just like a portal to another dimension! When a ball touches this pickup, it will disappear for a moment before being teleported to a random position on the map! And stay frosty as the ball will maintain its momentum as it exits the Black Hole!
[h2]Steam Integration[/h2]

For our Steam players, we've added new Steam integrations into this update! [i]2nd Base[/i] now supports Steam Rich Presence. There's also a button prompt to start an Online match using [i]Remote Play Together[/i]. And we've even added [b]Steam Achievements[/b]!

In order to add Steam Achievements, though, we also needed a way to track your stats. And that's why [i]2nd Base[/i] now incorporates a Stats panel on the Main Menu. (Note that this is available to all players, not just our Steam customers!)

This is all stored local to your device for maximum privacy. However, we have enabled Steam Cloud Saves which will back up your settings and your stats across devices!

[h2]Balancing & More[/h2]
We've also taken the opportunity to balance the game, refine the controls, update the physics of the balls, and improve the player experience. (We've fixed a longstanding bug with popover menus closing their parent modal window.) And whole lot more! 

You can check out the absolutely MASSIVE changelog for the game here. And make sure you subscribe to our [url=https://heavyelement.io/newsletter]email newsletter[/url] where we do giveaways, show off behind the scenes stuff, and drop previews of our in-development work!

If you already own the game on Steam, you can just start playing. If you have the game on Itch you'll need to download the latest update. And if don't own the game yet, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1905160/Dudelings_Arcade_Sportsball/?utm_source=second-base-he-press-release]get it here on Steam[/url]!
